feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 5:59pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 23 October 2026 at 6:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Gale warning in operation.


##Synopsis##

A deep low (Storm Austen) lies in the English Channel tracking eastwards, as a new rapidly deepening Atlantic low (Storm Boelo) tracks eastwards driving frontal troughs into the area by dawn tomorrow.


##Wind##

Northwest force 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8 at first, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 tonight. Increasing 5 or 6 early Saturday morning, then increasing south 7 to severe gale 9 later on Saturday morning. Veering west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough falling mainly moderate tonight, then quickly building rough or very rough Saturday morning. Rough or very rough tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Showers at first soon becoming mostly fair. Then heavy rain spreading from the west from dawn on Saturday.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in showers. Falling moderate or poor in rain tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest gale 8 or severe gale 9, decreasing 7 or gale 8 later in the afternoon, then 6 or 7 later..


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, becoming mainly very rough Saturday evening & overnight into Sunday.


##Weather##

Heavy rain soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in heavy rain, soon becoming mostly good, occasionally moderate in showers.
